requirements.statement: Compile raw intent into one portable, hash-bound, resumable execution bundle without requirement or decision loss.

Make ordinary conversation a sufficient first-class entrypoint and compile conversation, optional slash commands, CLI/API calls, and native host actions into the same canonical WorkRequest; /goal remains optional and never authoritative.
Require self-contained worker recipes, disjoint ownership, intent receipts, checkpoints, amendments, and bounded repair.
Reconcile intent, requirements, claims, tasks, diff, evidence, source locks, providers, hosts, and runtime projections mechanically.
Support every registered host adapter while returning UNSUPPORTED rather than false parity for unknown hosts.
Detect installed coding hosts from multiple live facts and fully synchronize selected skills/providers only to installed hosts.
Store external skills, tools, MCP servers, and apps as pinned source/install/provenance records with qualification and rollback.
Materialize every selected skill completely and portably across all installed hosts while keeping unselected candidates link-only.
Integrate claim-routed providers for disposable dependencies, API contracts, schema testing, UI, mobile, security, performance, and telemetry.
Prefer real browser or device behavior for business-flow proof and deterministic scripts for contracts without ceremonial overtesting.
Run local browser, mobile, and Pencil sessions visibly in the foreground; allow headless mode only in explicit CI profiles.
Discover Pencil dynamically without persisting ephemeral AppImage mount paths and auto-install official user-space packages when safe.
Route skills, capabilities, providers, and verifiers from deterministic facts, impact, claim class, availability, and risk.
Keep one owner per rule, skill, provider, host delta, and plan-local decision while preserving proven legacy behavior until parity.
Bound every CI process and wait, keep hosted quality required, and prevent unavailable self-hosted runners from blocking indefinitely.
Dogfood compiled recipes, reconciliation, provider routing, evidence, and runtime parity during this phase.
Compact completed plan data without deleting original intent, decisions, source locks, requirement-to-evidence traceability, or PASS evidence.
Prepare exact owner-gated Git closeout, final main CI, installed-host reinstall, and deletion of approved non-main branches only.

Model the harness as a typed closed-loop control system with feedforward and feedback sensors, evidence freshness and independence, explicit failure-to-eval conversion, expiring model-specific workarounds, and bounded runtime clamps.

Audit and converge high-impact rules and skills semantically, including lifecycle, planning, completion, context, delegation, research, browser QA, quality, and UI precedence, while keeping full-catalog structural fixtures green.

Keep Control Plane work ineligible until every selected skill, provider, tool, MCP, rule, command, host adapter, runtime projection, verification claim, installed-host receipt, required CI check, and owner-approved harness closeout is complete; then run Control Plane V2 as the final phase.

Support ordinary-prompt pair repair with raw-finding preservation, classification, claim-impact analysis, selective reopen, fresh evidence epochs, bounded repair packets, and immutable historical PASS evidence.

open_findings.reason: Owner discovery: Pencil is a desktop app-first surface. Discovery must try the live desktop app + MCP socket before the CLI; the desktop app login is sufficient for MCP interaction — CLI login is NOT required. Current harness routes Pencil via CLI/pen and treats CLI auth as a prerequisite, which blocks an already-logged-in desktop user.

Owner discovery: browser and MCP sessions must be durable and visible. Local browser QA must keep one persistent visible session (not open/close per check), and any visual-capable MCP/app must surface to the user in the foreground so the owner can watch and interact directly. Current harness opens/closes sessions per proof step.

REQ-016/AC-016/C-016 was recorded PASS from validator-only evidence (node automation/validate-entrypoint-parity.mjs) although the claim requires dogfood of compiled recipes, reconciliation, provider routing, evidence, and runtime parity. Validator PASS proves structural parity only; no real task or runtime execution observes the claim. Claim selectively reopened in candidate epoch 2; affected evidence stale for epoch 2; fresh live-stage proof required. Historical PASS and evidence file preserved. REQ-019/AC-019/C-019 reviewed and unaffected (closed-loop model is provable by schema/validator evidence and does not assert dogfood/live).

Runner-loop telemetry exists and is privacy-safe, but ordinary desktop conversation on the opencode host does not pass through the runner loop by default, so real usage is NOT observed there. Explicit ingest paths exist (agent-rules run/ingest). Live state for conversation-originated work remains LIVE_UNPROVEN until a host hook routes real sessions into telemetry. No simulated data may fill this gap.

Pre-existing worktree divergence (owner-rewritten Overview.tsx renders plan_id as h1; committed packages/engine/test/browser-qa.test.ts expects heading "Repository Overview"). Fails in verify:all. Unrelated to AM-0005 evidence-boundary work; neither the page nor the test was modified here. Owner must reconcile the rewrite with the route-rendering test.

Owner correction (AM-0006): MCP GUI launches (Playwright, Chrome DevTools, Pencil) can steal keyboard focus, switch the owner virtual desktop, or open on the owner current desktop instead of the OpenCode session desktop. Harness modeled only foreground/headless with no source-window binding, target-workspace placement, or focus preservation contract. Global OpenCode config also drifts: @latest versions without --isolated, Pencil persisted /tmp/.mount_Pen.* path. Affected acceptance REQ-011/AC-011, REQ-012/AC-012, REQ-013/AC-013, REQ-016/AC-016 selectively reopened in candidate epoch 3; historical PASS preserved.

Installed OpenCode global config: playwright @playwright/mcp@latest without --isolated; chrome-devtools chrome-devtools-mcp@latest without --isolated; pencil command persisted an ephemeral AppImage mount /tmp/.mount_Pen.ApAaTc9W/... (stale on app restart). All enabled globally, making Pencil effectively always-exposed. Must reconcile to canonical pinned + --isolated + stable launcher + bounded activation while preserving unrelated keys.

AM-0006 implemented: focus/workspace boundary enforced by canonical backend (focus-workspace.ts + mcp-guardian.mjs), per-task materialization fail-closed without binding, installed OpenCode config reconciled (pinned + --isolated + guardian + stable Pencil launcher), Cinnamon focus-new-windows set strict locally with receipt. Runtime browser test passed (source workspace 4, owner desktop/active preserved, browser placed headed+isolated). Pencil stays BLOCKED/NEEDS_USER (not running, explicit-only, no auto-launch).

Wrapper implemented (platforms/opencode/wrappers/session-launch.mjs) and demonstrated through a real opencode session. Remaining: wire the wrapper as the default interactive session launch so owners never export env manually. Unbound sessions stay fail-closed (NEEDS_USER) at GUI MCP use time.

AM-0006 repair: receipt semantics fixed. placeAndVerify now RE-SNAPSHOTS after the non-activating move and grants placement=placed only when a post-move snapshot proves providerWorkspace === targetWorkspace; otherwise verification-failed/blocked (a wmctrl exit code alone is never acceptance). findNewWindow now attributes strictly (exact _NET_WM_PID, then /proc descendant process tree) and never falls back to "first new window"; unattributed windows fail closed. Schema adds verification-failed. Runtime proof through a real opencode session with wrapper-injected binding: providerWorkspace=4===targetWorkspace=4, owner desktop/active unchanged.

Session-launch wrapper implemented: per-session opencode config injects AGENT_RULES_SOURCE_WINDOW_ID/AGENT_RULES_TARGET_WORKSPACE/AGENT_RULES_MCP_SESSION_ID into the managed MCP entries from the session-terminal binding resolution; multi-candidate ambiguity fails closed (unbound session, GUI MCPs NEEDS_USER at use time). Verified through a real opencode session. Remaining: making the wrapper the default launch path (opt-in today).
